doseRatios.equivalencyNote: Approximate clinical equivalency: fluoxetine 20 mg ≈ sertraline 100 mg (Maudsley 14th). Norfluoxetine carry-over justifies the slower upward sertraline titration. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

rule.rationale: Switching off fluoxetine because of inefficacy or side effects. The cross-taper is deliberately short because norfluoxetine continues to circulate for 1-2 weeks after fluoxetine is stopped, providing a built-in pharmacological bridge. Sertraline is started low and titrated slowly to avoid additive serotonergic load while norfluoxetine clears. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Start sertraline 25 mg in the morning. Hold fluoxetine 20 mg.
Stop fluoxetine. Norfluoxetine will continue for 1-2 weeks — counsel patient that the ‘bridge’ is invisible but real.
Increase sertraline to 50 mg. Watch for serotonergic excess (tremor, hyperreflexia).
